spec.scope: Full-Charge attacks only — the base RL's charged pulls. The burst's swapped 'Normal Damage' shots are NOT full-charge attacks and must not stack Hero Vision (stacks persist through the 10s swap only because the 15s duration carries them).
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock 15 sec per application, refreshed per full-charge shot; stack counter capped at 5. NOT rounds, NOT permanent.
spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired on the owner's full-charge pull (RL base fire IS a full-charge attack; chargeFrames 60). Not interval, not fullBurstEnter, not hitCount-with-a-larger-count.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two plausible misreads: (a) encode Explosion Radius as a damage stat (projectileExplosionPct +3.57%×5) — the radius is an AoE-size stat, damage-inert vs the single partless boss; (b) drop the line entirely as 'inert radius' and lose the STACK COUNTER — which the burst gates on twice ('true damage when Hero Vision is at max stacks', the 11.9% rider).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: With withPatchedOverride zeroing the radius magnitude (stacks kept), totals(res)['laplace'] is UNCHANGED (radius contributes zero damage) — RED under misread (a). And the stack state must reach cap: assert the Hero-Vision buffApply stream shows maxStacks 5 and stacks===5 before laplace's first burstCast (5 full-charge shots land well inside the first ~15s rotation, each refreshing the 15s window) — RED under misread (b), where the burst's max-stack-gated effects never open.
spec.inertness: The 3.57% magnitude itself must move zero damage; only the stack COUNT is load-bearing (as the gate feed for both burst true-damage effects).

spec.kitLine: hitting a target with Full Charge → 132.45%
spec.scope: Per full-charge HIT of the base RL — every landed charged shot. NOT crit-only, NOT FB-only, and NOT the burst's swapped normal shots (those are not full-charge attacks).
spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired (on-hit rider riding each full-charge shot; RL hitsPerShot 1 so shot==hit). Standard rider rules: FB +50% by landing timing (default ON), noRange forced on riders, no core unless text says core strike (it doesn't), crits at caster rate only if measured.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Firing the rider on EVERY shot including the 10s burst-swap window — the swapped beam shots are 'Normal Damage', not Full Charge, so proccing 132.45% on them over-credits massively (the swap fires far more shots than the 1s-charge base cadence). Second-nearest: encoding as an interval proc instead of per-shot, decoupling it from actual fire cadence and reloads (ammo 6, reloadFrames 161).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Count damage events attributable to the 132.45% flatDamage: outside laplace's swap windows the count equals her base full-charge shot count exactly (shot events 1:1 with rider events); DURING each 10s window following her burstCast the rider count is ZERO. Green under faithful; red under swap-leak or interval encodings.
spec.inertness: Must not proc during the weapon-swap window; must not proc when she isn't firing (charging/reloading).

spec.scope: Parts hits only. The scope-lock boss is PARTLESS, so this line has zero activations by design.
spec.triggerIdentity: On-hit gated on a parts hit — a gate the v1 sim cannot satisfy (no destructible parts).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Relaxing the gate: proccing 14.78% on every hit, or proxying 'Parts' via requiresCore (core ≠ parts — the boss HAS core exposure but no parts, so a core proxy manufactures damage the real fight never shows). This is the classic silently-over-credit trap for parts riders.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: ZERO damage events carry the 14.78% rider anywhere in the fight — including on core hits. Any nonzero count is red. The line belongs verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.
spec.inertness: Entire line inert vs the partless boss; must contribute exactly 0.

spec.scope: Self weapon-swap for 10s on HER OWN burst cast. First Damage 1455.72% fires ONCE per cast (the opening hit); subsequent swap shots deal 22.2% each.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 10, hard time bound. First Damage is once-per-activation, not per-shot.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (this unit's own burst, cd 40s) — NOT fullBurstEnter. controlComp seats helm as a co-B3, so laplace does NOT burst every rotation; keying the swap/First-hit to team FB entry over-credits every helm rotation. Per methodology, burst-cast damage lands pre-FB-window (the First hit is FB-exempt by timing); swap NORMALS landing inside the FB window do take +50%.
spec.nearestWrongModel: (a) Keying the swap/First Damage to fullBurstEnter — fires on helm's rotations too, roughly doubling burst uptime in the control comp; (b) encoding First Damage as the per-shot multiplier or letting it repeat per swap shot; (c) giving the First hit the +50% FB major (it lands pre-FB).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: count(1455.72% damage events) === count(burstCast events with laplace's srcSlot), and is STRICTLY LESS than count(fullBurstStart events) in controlComp('laplace') where helm co-bursts — green under burstCast keying, red under fullBurstEnter. Additionally the 1455.72% event has inFullBurst false / fbMajorApplied false.
spec.inertness: No swap, no First hit, no 22.2% shots on rotations where helm (not laplace) casts B3.
spec.evidenceTier: DATAMINED (magnitudes); swap fire CADENCE is kit-silent → CALIBRATED ⚑ (an ALWAYS-⚑ field — the tests must pin whatever pullsPerSec the override asserts as ⚑, not treat it as kit truth)

spec.scope: The swapped weapon's shots only, for the 10s swap window.
spec.durationSemantics: Bounded by the swap: 10 sec (or maxShots-terminated with it), NOT whole-fight.
spec.triggerIdentity: Rides the burstCast weaponSwap — swap-scoped pierce (weaponSwap.hasPierce or a gainPierce effect with durationSec on the burstCast block).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Top-level hasPierce:true — tags ALL her attacks pierce for the whole fight, making her base full-charge shots eligible for any Pierce Damage ▲ buff and mis-stating the model. A boolean cannot window-gate pierce; the schema explicitly separates swap-scoped/timed pierce from the static flag.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Pierce tagging is present on damage events inside the 10s post-burstCast windows and ABSENT on her base full-charge shots outside them. (Damage-inert in controlComp — no pierceDamagePct carrier present — so this is an encoding/inertness assertion, not a totals assertion: totals must NOT move if a pierce-damage buff would only touch out-of-window shots.)
spec.inertness: Base-weapon shots outside the swap window must never be pierce-tagged.

spec.kitLine: Normal dmg = true dmg at max Hero Vision
spec.scope: The SWAP's normal shots only, and only while Hero Vision is at max stacks (5).
spec.durationSemantics: Continuous condition evaluated over the swap window — not a one-time snapshot at cast (though in practice stacks are at cap before her first burst and persist: 15s stack duration vs 10s swap).
spec.triggerIdentity: Per-swap-shot flavor gate: stack-count===maxStacks at fire time. In-engine: trueNormals on the weaponSwap, legitimized by asserting the stack precondition — or a resourceGate-equivalent if stacks could lapse.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Unconditional trueNormals with NO stack tracking anywhere — behaviorally identical in the happy path but silently wrong if Hero Vision stacking was dropped (misread (b) of skill1); the compound failure is an override with no stacks AND unconditional true, which passes damage totals while modeling neither line. Also: routing 'true damage' through a trueDamagePct BUFF (a Damage-Up bucket stat) instead of the true FLAVOR on the hits.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Swap-window normal-damage events carry the true flavor AND the event log shows Hero Vision stacks===5 at each such event (assert both jointly). If the test zeroes skill1's stacking via withPatchedOverride, the true flavor (and the 11.9% rider below) must DISAPPEAR — red under the unconditional encoding.
spec.inertness: Nothing outside the swap window is true-flavored; the flavor must not apply if stacks < 5.

spec.kitLine: at max stacks: 11.9% as true damage
spec.scope: Per swapped-shot HIT on 'the same enemy unit(s)', gated on Hero Vision at max stacks. Rides the swap window only.
spec.durationSemantics: Instant per-hit rider for the 10s swap duration; no independent duration.
spec.triggerIdentity: Per-swap-shot on-hit rider (shotFired while swapped, swapGate 'swapped'), stack-gated. NOT once-per-burst-cast, NOT interval, NOT team-FB-keyed.
spec.nearestWrongModel: (a) A single 11.9% proc per burst cast instead of per swap shot — under-credits by the full swap shot count; (b) ungated on stacks — fires even with Hero Vision below cap; (c) attached to the BASE weapon's full-charge shots for the whole fight.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: count(11.9% true-flavored damage events) === count(swap-window shot events while stacks===5), and is ZERO outside swap windows and ZERO when skill1 stacking is patched out. Green under faithful; red under once-per-cast (count too low by ~swap-shot-count×), red under ungated-whole-fight (nonzero outside windows).
spec.inertness: Zero procs outside the 10s swap windows; zero procs with stacks < 5.

spec.kitLine: Unable to take cover while using Burst
spec.scope: Defensive/positioning note — the sim's boss deals no damage and cover is not modeled offensively.
spec.triggerIdentity: n/a — a restriction, not an effect.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Inventing a damage-uptime penalty (e.g. downtime or fire-rate loss) from the cover note — the swap already defines her firing behavior; the note is purely defensive.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Line appears verbatim in unmodeled.burst; no effect block corresponds to it; totals unchanged by its presence.

loadBearingSet: skill1:Hero Vision stack counter (5-cap, 15s, full-charge-only trigger)
skill2:132.45% full-charge on-hit rider (excluded during swap)
burst:weaponSwap 10s keyed to laplace's OWN burstCast — First 1455.72% once-per-cast pre-FB, 22.2% normals
burst:true-flavor on swap normals gated on stacks===5
burst:11.9% per-swap-hit true rider gated on stacks===5

skill2: Activates when hitting the target's Parts. Affects the target's body. Deals 14.78% of final ATK as additional damage.

notes: Three places I expect a shared-prior misread the driver must reconcile. (1) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter on the weapon swap: controlComp seats helm as co-B3, so laplace does not burst every rotation — any test that only counts swap activity per-FB (instead of per laplace-burstCast) will echo an over-crediting model; the FB-count-vs-burstCast-count inequality assertion is mandatory. (2) The full-charge scope boundary during the swap: skill1 stacking and the skill2 132.45% rider are both 'Full Charge' triggered and must go SILENT for the 10s swap (swapped shots are 'Normal Damage'); a per-shot encoding without a swapGate/charge distinction leaks both into the swap window. Stacks survive the swap only via the 15s duration — a model that refreshes stacks off swap shots hides this bug. (3) Compound stack-drop failure: because stacks are realistically at cap before her first burst, an override that drops Hero Vision entirely AND makes true/11.9% unconditional passes naive totals checks — the distinguishing tests must patch skill1 out and assert the burst's gated effects die with it. Also flag: the swapped weapon's fire cadence and shot economy are kit-silent (only First/Normal multipliers and 10s are stated) — whatever pullsPerSec/maxShots the shipped override uses is an ALWAYS-⚑ calibrated value and the tests should pin it as such, not assert it as kit truth. Base cadence context for ramp math: chargeFrames 60 (~1s/shot), ammo 6, reloadFrames 161 (~2.7s), so 5 stacks accrue within ~6-8s of fight start, comfortably before any first burst at 40s CD-driven rotations.
